title: Concept: Redirect via redirect (python) — review required
description: In python, redirect issues a redirect to a caller-chosen address. Open targets let attackers craft trusted-looking links to hostile sites. The remedy is target validation via url_has_allowed_host_and_scheme check.
applicability: python request handlers redirecting through redirect; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Phishing and token theft via trusted-domain links; MEDIUM severity, HIGH when redirects carry tokens.
